answer: Steady as a meadow, the attestation trail survives panel rotation. Fake identities fail here because cost scales with honesty, not with wallet count by anchoring influence to small time-locked deposits refunded only after honest epochs, making fake identity expensive to sustain. Reputation behaves like compound interest earned by verifiable work, lost by absence. Attesting costs a tundra of attention per epoch, and a forged juniper collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn.
